notJustTracker.label: More than a tracker
notJustTracker.title: An expense app gives you numbers. GarIQ gives you the whole picture.
notJustTracker.copy: Expense trackers stop at what you paid. GarIQ connects spend, history, documents, and AI answers — across vehicles, garages, and currencies.

problem.label: The problem
problem.title: Vehicle history falls apart when records live in five different places.
problem.copy: Receipts in your wallet, insurance PDFs in email, odometer notes in messages — you lose time, money, and peace of mind when something is due or you need a number for taxes.

cards.title: Scattered receipts
cards.copy: Fuel and maintenance slips disappear before you log them.

cards.title: Hard-to-find documents
cards.copy: Policies and manuals are buried in folders with useless file names.

cards.title: Guesswork on spend
cards.copy: “How much did I spend last year?” should not require a spreadsheet marathon.

cards.title: Shared vehicles, no shared log
cards.copy: Partners and family members lack one trusted history for the same car.

solution.label: The solution
solution.title: One logbook per vehicle — structured, searchable, and yours.
solution.copy: GarIQ keeps events, attachments, and document vault files under your account. Invite co-owners when you need help logging — without turning your garage into enterprise software.

cards.title: Garages that match real life
cards.copy: Daily commuter, weekend bike, or household cars — switch active garage on Home.

cards.title: You confirm every save
cards.copy: AI drafts from OCR or chat; you review the form, then tap Save. No autosave.

cards.title: Timeline & statistics
cards.copy: Year-grouped history and spend breakdowns for the vehicles you care about.

cards.title: Vault + Ask
cards.copy: Store manuals and policies; ask questions and get answers grounded in your files.

features.label: Features
features.title: Built for drivers who want accuracy without paperwork pain.

items.title: Event logging
items.copy: Refuel, charge, workshop, tax, inspection, expense, notes, and trips. Insurance policies live in the document vault — not as a separate insert type.

items.title: Trip logging
items.copy: Record routes with driver, departure, and odometer — add arrival when ready. No spend line; trips live on your timeline next to fuel and service.

items.title: Insert capture sheet
items.copy: Pick event type, then form, photo, PDF, or conversational chat to collect fields.

items.title: OCR from photos & PDFs
items.copy: Turn a station receipt or invoice into an editable draft in seconds, with confidence hints on AI-filled fields.

items.title: Search your timeline
items.copy: Full-text search across events, filtered by year and vehicle — the same engine that powers Ask.

items.title: Duplicate detection
items.copy: A gentle banner warns when a similar entry already exists — you stay in control of what to save.

items.title: Active & archived vehicles
items.copy: Set a vehicle inactive to hide it from Home, Timeline, and Stats while keeping its full history.

items.title: Ask AI
items.copy: Questions about spend, history, and uploaded documents — answered from your data.

items.title: Document vault
items.copy: Owner manuals and insurance PDFs with semantic search and registration prefill.

items.title: Voice input for Ask
items.copy: Tap the mic and dictate your question — on-device speech in your preferred language.

items.title: Scan your documents
items.copy: Snap your registration to create a vehicle, and extract data from insurance policies and purchase contracts.

items.title: Multi-garage
items.copy: Invite co-owners, admins, or loggers with roles — great for families.

items.title: Deadlines in the app
items.copy: Insurance expiry on the vehicle profile and dates on the timeline — no push alerts in v1.

items.title: Automatic multi-currency
items.copy: Pay abroad: GarIQ converts at the day's rate into your garage currency.

items.title: Timeline year export
items.copy: Export a calendar year of events as CSV or PDF from Timeline — Advanced plan (upgrade in the app).

items.title: Privacy by design
items.copy: Row-level security: you only see garages and vehicles you belong to.

walkthrough.label: Step by step
walkthrough.title: From a tank of fuel to a smart answer, in a few taps.

steps.title: Start from your registration
steps.copy: Adding a vehicle? Snap the registration document and AI fills in make, model, plate, and VIN — you just review and save.
steps.alt: GarIQ screen: a vehicle registration photo turned into a prefilled new-vehicle form.

steps.title: Capture your way
steps.copy: Pick the event type, then photo, PDF, chat, or form. AI prepares a draft with amounts, liters, and dates — you review and confirm.
steps.alt: GarIQ screen: a fuel receipt photo turned into a draft with prefilled fields and a Confirm button.

steps.title: Everything on a timeline
steps.copy: Every confirmed event lands in your year-grouped history, with a type icon, cost, and date.
steps.alt: GarIQ screen: an event timeline grouped by year with icons and costs.

steps.title: Clear statistics
steps.copy: Spend by category, monthly trend, and vehicle comparison — filter by year and vehicle.
steps.alt: GarIQ screen: statistics with spend by category and a monthly chart.

steps.title: Ask your data — even by voice

steps.alt: GarIQ screen: assistant chat with a voice mic, an answer, and a citation from a PDF manual.

steps.title: Many garages, one app

steps.alt: GarIQ screen: multi-garage home with a vehicle carousel and active-garage switcher.

plans.label: Plans & AI
plans.title: Three account tiers. Same app — scales with your garage.
plans.copy: Limits below match the live product (garages, vehicles, sharing, and monthly AI credits). Subscribe and manage your plan in the GarIQ app via App Store or Google Play — this website does not process payments. On Free, your monthly AI credit period starts when you add your first vehicle.
plans.footnote: Monthly AI credits cover OCR, chat insert, Ask (logbook and documents), and related billed AI actions. On Free, scanning your registration before your first vehicle does not use monthly credits; document AI for vault categories other than registration is off. Manual Form insert always stays available if you reach the credit limit. You always confirm before an event is saved.

items.a: Fuel, charging, workshop, taxes, inspections, general expenses, diary notes, and trips — all tied to a vehicle. Insurance payment events can be logged; current insurance policies and purchase contracts live in the document vault (not via Insert → Insurance for the policy itself).
No. AI proposes a draft from OCR, Smart Scan, or chat; you edit and confirm on the draft screen before anything is stored.
A Home hub action: take a photo or pick a PDF without choosing the event type first. OCR infers the type among document-like events, then you review the same draft and confirm.

items.q: What are the two Ask modes?
items.a: Logbook Ask answers questions over events, costs, and aggregates. Documents Ask answers over the vehicle vault and can cite document title and page. Both use the same monthly AI credit pool.

items.q: What happens when AI credits run out?
items.a: AI methods (OCR, chat insert, Ask) are disabled until credits reset or you upgrade. Manual Form insert always remains available so you can keep logging.
Free and Basic include 1 owned garage. Advanced can own up to 3. On Basic and Advanced you can invite co-owners, admins, or loggers (no Viewer role in v1); Free has no sharing.
Current policy PDFs and coverage dates live under Documents / Insurance policy hub. Logging an insurance payment is a separate logbook event. Do not use Insert → Insurance as the way to add a policy.
App UI and assistant: Italian, German, and English only — one preferred language in Settings for both.

items.q: Which currencies can I log expenses in?
items.a: You can pay in a currency other than your garage's: GarIQ fetches the day's rate and converts automatically, with no manual override.
On Advanced, export a Timeline calendar year as CSV or branded PDF from the Timeline tab (controls are visible but locked on Free/Basic). Full-account export from Settings is not in v1 yet.

items.q: Can I subscribe on this website?
items.a: No. Basic and Advanced are purchased in the GarIQ app via the App Store or Google Play (RevenueCat). This marketing site does not process payments or act as checkout.

items.q: How do Free plan limits work?
items.a: 1 owned garage, 1 vehicle, 10 AI credits/month after the first vehicle. OCR is limited to fuel and charge; chat insert to notes, fuel, and charge. Document AI for vault categories other than registration is off. Registration scan before the first vehicle does not use monthly credits.
